EVENTS.AGRI_ONBOARDING_SETUPTAVERN_DESC: Time to celebrate! Start by placing your Festival Grounds and set up tables, a stage, and some decorations. These items are only displayed during festivals; they will then be stored until next time.
EVENTS.AGRI_ONBOARDING_SETUPMEAL_DESC: Your villagers are ready to pig out on whatever the Tavern has to offer! To keep them well-fed during the feast, make sure your Tavern Kitchen is staffed with Cooks and that you have all the right ingredients.
EVENTS.AGRI_ONBOARDING_PREPAREFESTIVAL_DESC: You're all set for your first Harvest Festival! Head to the Festival Grounds and start the preparations. Make sure you have a Festive Meal on the menu and that a Juggler has been invited!
EVENTS.AGRI_ONBOARDING_SETUPTAVERN_CHOICE_A: We will set the Festival Grounds.
EVENTS.AGRI_ONBOARDING_SETUPTAVERN_COMPLETION_D: With the festival set up at the Tavern, all you need now is to prepare the feast!
EVENTS.AGRI_ONBOARDING_SETUPMEAL_COMPLETION_DES: With all the ingredients in stock, your Harvest Festival is ready to begin!
EVENTS.AGRI_ONBOARDING_PREPAREFESTIVAL_COMPLETI: Your first festival was a success, and it's just the beginning!
EVENTS.AGRI_ONBOARDING_SETUPTAVERN_QUEST_DESC: I need to build the Festival Grounds at my Tavern.
EVENTS.AGRI_ONBOARDING_SETUPMEAL_QUEST_DESC: I need to produce ingredients for my Festival meals.
EVENTS.AGRI_ONBOARDING_PREPAREFESTIVAL_QUEST_DE: I am ready to host my first Harvest Festival.
EVENTS.AGRI_CROFTONBOARDING_COMMON_DESC: Your villagers want to raise chickens! They say that once you have a healthy flock, it'll provide a steady supply of Eggs and Meat. Better yet, Crofts are compact and can be easily built right next to your villagers' homes.
EVENTS.AGRI_CROFTONBOARDING_MONASTIC_DESC: Your monastics want to raise chickens! They say that once you have a healthy flock, it'll provide a steady supply of Eggs and ingredients for Monastic Meals. Better yet, Crofts are compact and can be easily built within the nooks of your monastery.
EVENTS.AGRI_CROFTONBOARDING_SUCCESS_DESC: Croft productivity increases over time, as long as animals are well fed.
EVENTS.AGRI_CROFTONBOARDING_COMMON_QUEST_DESC: I have agreed to build a Common Croft in my village.
EVENTS.AGRI_CROFTONBOARDING_MONASTERY_QUEST_DES: I have agreed to build a Monastic Croft in my monastery.
EVENTS.AGRI_FESTIVALSTART_DESC: Your villagers will gather at the Festival Grounds to celebrate this promising Harvest Festival.
EVENTS.AGRI_TRADEEVENT_DESC: Labourers from a neighbouring farmstead are looking for work! Word is that our village's granaries are well-stocked, and they'd be willing to provide us some of their workers in exchange for food.
EVENTS.AGRI_TRADEEVENT_CHOICE_A_TOOLTIP: You will exchange food for new villagers.
EVENTS.AGRI_TRADEEVENT_CHOICE_B_TOOLTIP: You will sell food for coins.
EVENTS.AGRI_TRADEEVENT_CHOICE_C: Take the food, we have enough.
EVENTS.AGRI_TRADEEVENT_CHOICE_C_TOOLTIP: You will donate food, earning you influence.
EVENTS.AGRI_TRADEEVENT_CHOICE_NO: We can't spare anything at the moment.
EVENTS.AGRI_TRADEEVENT_CHOICE_NO_TOOLTIP: The labourers might ask again later.
EVENTS.AGRI_TRADEEVENT_SUCCESS_DESC: Food has been given to the labourers to stock their farmstead's granary!

DESCRIPTOR.AGRI_FESTIVAL_HAPPINESSFACTOR_BONUS_DESC: The Harvest Festival was a success! Your villagers rejoice over this wonderful event, though the Happiness bonus will gradually fade.

ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_STEP_1_TITLE: A Granary of the Realm, Part I
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_STEP_1_DESC:
A minstrel demands an audience, offering not just sweet tunes for your ears, but a spark of joy to nurture your whole village. He explains that this land holds wild abundance that, with enough sweat and heart, could become a vast, wonderful garden worth celebrating!

He reminds you once more: abundance is nothing without labour.
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_STEP_1_CHOICE: The Minstrel will help you establish farms worthy of celebrations.
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_STEP_2_TITLE: A Granary of the Realm, Part II
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_STEP_2_DESC:
This first celebration proved your village is truly blessed with fertile land... and hardworking labourers!

The minstrel suggests dedicating the next harvest festival to them, ensuring everyone reaps the rewards of their labour.
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_STEP_2_CHOICE: The Minstrel will help you celebrate your people.
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_STEP_3_TITLE: A Granary of the Realm, Part III
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_STEP_3_DESC:
The Minstrel marvels at your people's hard work, turning wonderful wilderness into bountiful farmlands. Their reward is a life of abundance, where no one goes hungry.

Today, your land is prosperous, and that's as good a reason as any for your next harvest festival!
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_STEP_3_CHOICE: The Minstrel will help you celebrate your prosperity.
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_STEP_4_TITLE: A Granary of the Realm, Part IV
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_STEP_4_DESC:
The Minstrel arrives with great news! Tales of your bountiful harvest festivals have reached the Royal Court, and the King himself demands a visit.

Hosting such a distinguished crowd will demand considerable resources, but nothing your village can't grow!
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_STEP_4_CHOICE: We will celebrate with our good King!
The Minstrel will help you host your King.
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_CHOICE_NO_TOO: The Minstrel will ask you again later.
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_REWARD_HAPPIN: Your King acknowledged the abundance of your farmlands and the hard work of your people.
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_REWARD_TITLE: A Granary of the Realm, Part V
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_REWARD_DESC:
The King, his retinue, and your entire village feasted and cheered to each other's good health. At the royal throne, everyone agreed: your farmlands are more than enough to sustain the entire realm!

Without a doubt, it is the true granary of the realm.
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_REWARD_CHOICE: Our garden is for the realm to enjoy, my liege!
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_REWARD_COMPLE: Your land is known far and wide as the granary of the realm!
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_STEP_1_SUCCES: You celebrated your first harvest festival with the delicious yield of your fields.
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_STEP_2_SUCCES: You celebrated the hard work of your villagers with a well-deserved harvest festival.
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_STEP_3_SUCCES: You celebrated the prosperity of your land with refinement and abundance.
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_STEP_4_SUCCES: You celebrated the abundance of your farmlands with a royal tribute from your King.
ASPIRATION.EVENT_ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_OPPORTU: The Minstrel has a request concerning your village.
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_STEP_1_QUEST_: I have agreed to establish farmlands and celebrate their yield with a harvest festival.
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_STEP_2_QUEST_: I have agreed to celebrate the hard labour of my people.
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_STEP_3_QUEST_: I have agreed to celebrate the prosperity of my land.
ASPIRATION.ASPIRATION_HARVESTFESTIVAL_STEP_4_QUEST_: I have agreed to invite the King and his retinue to our harvest festival.
ASPIRATION.VC_DLC_HARVESTFESTIVAL_DESC: For players who want to focus on farming and harvest festivals.
ASPIRATION.VC_DLC_HARVESTFESTIVAL_GOAL: Build a granary of the realm!
ASPIRATION.VC_DLC_HARVESTFESTIVAL_SUCCESS: As the minstrels wrap up their last song, you join your folks cheering on their harvest. Hard work paid off: you made a majestic garden out of this wild, wonderful land.

UNLOCKABLE.AGRI_FESTIVALPROGRESSION_MINSTREL_01_SUC: You can now hire a minstrel for your Harvest Festivals, provided you give him his stage to perform on.
UNLOCKABLE.AGRI_FESTIVALPROGRESSION_MINSTREL_02_SUC: You can now hire a duo of minstrels for your Harvest Festivals.
UNLOCKABLE.AGRI_FESTIVALPROGRESSION_MINSTREL_03_SUC: You can now hire an entire band of minstrels for your Harvest Festivals.
UNLOCKABLE.AGRI_FESTIVALPROGRESSION_JUGGLER_01_UNLO: You can now hire a juggler for your Harvest Festivals, provided you give them a stage to perform on.
UNLOCKABLE.AGRI_FESTIVALPROGRESSION_JUGGLER_02_UNLO: You can now hire a trio of jugglers for your Harvest Festivals.
UNLOCKABLE.AGRI_FESTIVALPROGRESSION_JUGGLER_03_UNLO: You can now hire a quintet of jugglers for your Harvest Festivals.
UNLOCKABLE.AGRI_FESTIVALPROGRESSION_THEATER_01_SUCC: You can now hire the Guivre Troupe for your Harvest Festivals, provided you give them a stage to perform on.

NEEDS.AGRI_VISITPIGSTY_DESC: Must visit a Pigsty to see how animals are tended to.
NEEDS.AGRI_VISITTURNIP_DESC: Must visit a Turnip Farm to see how plants are tended to.
